checks: Eight technical fields are compared from immutable source projections; impacts are deduplicated, no personal/source prose or working data enters the result.
Absent dimensions remain unknown, dimensions retain millimetres and budget preferences are displayed without a price calculation.
Contact/status-only changes remain import conflicts while the comparison honestly reports unchanged technical parameters and unknown source-field differences.
Older exports and changed content under the same revision receive distinct review warnings; ordering is never inferred from export time.
Mismatched identities, ambiguous matches and missing/corrupt projections refuse comparison instead of silently selecting an unrelated dossier.
Actual app preview shows semantic comparison rows against source quantity 2, not working quantity 9; it keeps creation disabled and writes no working mutation.
Opening the retained dossier uses its exact ID, clears source contact from the drawer, and preserves working quantity and notes.
The real UI keeps a source-only revision visible for review without incorrectly treating it as an accepted merge.
CSS parses, changed rows use explicit text as well as color, keyboard scrolling is named, and both reduced-motion paths disable comparison animation.
scope: Read-only technical comparison and real app/store in JSDOM, SHA-256-checked synthetic export fixtures. No sender authentication, printer, D1 account, social publication, email or payment.
